_comment: Glob -> service -> owner map for the per-service ownership layer (docs/designs/agents/service-owners.md). Consumed by: the PR-post rule (which #svc channel(s) a PR touches), the T-CI backstop hook, and the supervisor's incident routing. RESOLUTION: a changed path matches a service when it matches any entry in that service's `globs` OR equals its `spec` path (spec-update PRs route to the owning service, not a 'docs' service) AND is not caught by `exclude`; most-specific-wins by `priority` (higher wins) resolves overlaps (woodpecker's nix/ci paths outrank nix-infra/ci-build); a path notifies exactly one service, then the multi-service all-channels rule applies across DISTINCT services. Fork services (omp/cotal/woodpecker) carry `repos` and empty `globs`: they match by REPO (a PR opened in that fork), have no sealed/ path so the sealed CI backstop never fires for them (backstop:agent-posts-only) -> agent-posts-on-start is their only route. Every consumer MUST check `repos` (fork match) and `spec` (spec-update match), not `globs` alone.
